key.name: cat-count
key.description: How many cats live on the dock.

key.name: palettes
key.description: Palette names to assign to cats. Empty means use them all.

key.name: max-speed
key.summary: Top speed in pixels per second
key.description: How fast a cat can run along the dock.

key.name: mouse-attraction
key.description: How strongly cats are drawn to the pointer. 0 means they ignore it.

key.name: attract-radius
key.description: How far above the bottom of the screen the pointer can be and still interest the cats.

key.name: scratch-icons
key.description: Let cats stop at an app icon and claw at it.

key.name: wiggle-icons
key.description: Rock the real dock icon while a cat scratches it. Turn this off to leave the dock untouched.

key.name: sprite-size
key.description: 0 matches the dock's own icon size.

key.name: sleep-after
key.summary: Seconds of stillness before cats nap

key.name: bed-count
key.description: Beds placed along the floor beside the dock. A sleepy cat walks to a free one and curls up in it.

key.name: scratcher-count
key.description: Posts placed along the floor beside the dock for the cats to claw at.

key.name: bed-positions
key.description: One entry per bed: a percentage of the floor's width from the left edge of the dock's monitor. -1, or a missing entry, places that bed automatically.

key.name: scratcher-positions
key.description: One entry per post: a percentage of the floor's width from the left edge of the dock's monitor. -1, or a missing entry, places that post automatically.

key.name: mouse-interval
key.description: Roughly how often a mouse runs across the floor for the cats to hunt. 0 means no mice.
